title: Renovation Cost Estimate — €5/m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Detailed renovation cost estimate for an apartment or house: works, materials, furniture and appliances. €5/m² of floor area. Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Renovation cost estimates for apartments and houses in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: Renovation cost estimates for apartments and houses in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN prepares detailed cost estimates covering construction work, finishing work, and materials for the renovation of apartments, private homes, and other spaces in Bratislava and Vienna. With an estimate, you know the budget and the scope of work in advance and can plan your expenses.
The price is €5/m² of the property’s floor area. The calculation takes into account the actual dimensions of the rooms, the condition of the surfaces, and the planned work.
We measure the walls, floors, and ceilings and identify geometric deviations in the surfaces. Based on this data, we calculate the work quantities and the amount of materials needed.
This way, the estimate reflects the real condition of the property and comes closer to the actual costs.

blocks.text: Cost calculation for construction and finishing work

parts.html: The estimate includes a list of work items with quantities and costs: preparatory, construction, and finishing work, depending on the condition of the property and the planned renovation.
You can see what makes up the budget, compare contractor bids, and keep spending under control at every stage.

blocks.text: Specification of construction and finishing materials

parts.html: A separate section covers materials: how much construction and finishing material the work requires and how much it costs.
The specification helps you plan purchases and agree on the budget before the renovation begins. If the materials or the scope of work change, the calculation is adjusted.
A detailed renovation cost estimate: work quantities and costs, plus a list of materials with quantities and approximate costs.
You can use it to plan the budget and purchases, approve the work, and monitor spending.
The price for preparing an estimate is €5/m² of the property’s floor area.
If you order a renovation from DUMSKAYA DESIGN, the cost of preparing the estimate is deducted from the cost of the renovation work.

The estimate is based on the available information about the property and the agreed scope of work. Final costs may change if hidden defects are discovered or if design decisions, the scope of work, or material prices change.
